title: Repentant
summary: REPENT'ANT, adjective 1. Sorrowful for past conduct or words. 2. Sorrowful for sin. 3. Expressing or showing sorrow for sin; as repentant tears; repentant ashes; repentant sighs. REPENT'ANT, noun 1. O
